narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -2.82 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 343.83-347.84 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 352.74; the first objective pays 2.18R at 340.83.

plan.triggerRule: footprint sdiv fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 352.74 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: no positive-delta absorption or CVD divergence at the pullback zone

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 30/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below

factors.detail: CVD flat, bear div 19 bars ago

factors.name: Liquidation Gravity
factors.detail: long liq $9k -2.8% below · short liq $139 +4.0% above
